description: Find journals, transactions, and invoices without a directly attached base document. Counts are records without their own attachment — a bank transaction linked to an invoice that has a document is still counted. Item lists show 20 rows per section unless detail="full".

detail.description: compact (default): first 20 items per section, cut sections are marked truncated. full: every item.

title: Find Missing Documents
